# Axes on the Descent

*The highland traveler Knox waited for came down the Western Descent with a split pack and a story about stumps that swing axes. Torvi wants the Descent cleared before the next carts come down, and then wants you at the gate: Brindle is short of hands for the night watch.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 40 [Axe Stump](../monsters/axe_stump.md) in [Western Descent](../maps/western_descent.md)
2. Defeat 30 [Dark Stump](../monsters/dark_stump.md) in [Western Descent](../maps/western_descent.md)
